meta.title: NGINX HTTP/2 Flow-Control Heap Overflow (CVE-2026-123007)
meta.plainExplanation: Passively checks whether an NGINX endpoint exposes HTTP/2 on a version affected by the ngx_http_v2_module flow-control heap buffer overflow (CVE-2026-123007).
meta.whyItMatters: Unauthenticated clients sending crafted HTTP/2 flow-control sequences to affected NGINX versions can trigger a heap overflow causing worker crashes or potential remote code execution.
meta.defaultFix: Upgrade NGINX OSS to 1.30.7+ (stable) or 1.31.9+ (mainline), or NGINX Plus to R37 build 37.0.8.1+ or 37.3.0.1+. As an immediate mitigation, disable HTTP/2 (http2 off; / remove listen ... http2).
meta.remediation: Upgrade NGINX OSS to 1.30.7+ (stable) or 1.31.9+ (mainline), or NGINX Plus to R37 build 37.0.8.1+ or 37.3.0.1+. As an immediate mitigation, disable HTTP/2 (http2 off; / remove listen ... http2).

groupedFindings.fix: Upgrade NGINX OSS to 1.30.7+ (stable) or 1.31.9+ (mainline), or NGINX Plus to R37 build 37.0.8.1+ or 37.3.0.1+. As an immediate mitigation, disable HTTP/2 (http2 off; / remove listen ... http2).
